methodology.confidence_interval: deterministic percentile bootstrap 95% CI of process medians; 10000 resamples; seed 0
methodology.cpu_protocol: single-threaded Mojo loops; JAX CPU with BLAS threads=1 and XLA Eigen multithreading disabled
methodology.memory_metric: complete process peak RSS plus runtime baseline and non-negative planner delta
methodology.mojo_baseline: peak RSS of an independent no-op invocation of the same AOT binary
methodology.jax_baseline: same-process RSS after JAX and planner import, before fixture allocation
methodology.mojo_latency: std.benchmark mean per process with max_batch_size=1
methodology.jax_latency: mean synchronous block_until_ready call per process
